description: Xu Huang, powerful chinese general in the supplied pixel art style. A maroon cloth head wrap with long tails, dark armor with gold trim, a long maroon cape, dark boots. He holds a very large battle axe with a long dark shaft, gold fittings and a huge crescent blade
face: A grim face with a dark beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the maroon head wrap with its tails, dark armor, the long maroon cape, the great axe at his right side.
guard_action: both hands bring the pole axe to a ready angle in front of the body, the feet spread and the knees bend

actions.idle: Two-handed pole axe guard, the axe held at the right side, breathing
actions.move: Seamless combat run in place carrying the pole axe, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.a1: VERTICAL overhead axe blow. Frames 3-6 both hands raise the axe straight up above the head, the blade at the top; frames 7-8 it is brought down from above onto the target; frames 9-11 hold with the axe head low. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The great battle axe stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a2: HORIZONTAL axe swing, feet planted. Frames 2-6 the whole upper body winds far to the right with the axe held level; frames 7-8 the axe swings around from the side to the front in a wide flat arc; frames 9-11 hold in front. The axe travels sideways. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The great battle axe stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a3: RISING axe blow. Frames 3-6 the axe head drops low in front and the knees bend; frames 7-8 the head scoops up from below through the target; frame 9 it finishes high; frames 10-11 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The great battle axe stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s2: Great axe blow with a leap. Frames 1-4 he sinks low; frames 5-7 both feet leave the ground with the axe swung up over the right shoulder; frame 8 he lands driving the axe down into the target; frames 9-11 absorb the landing. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The great battle axe stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 a1 → a2 → a3, 전법 s2. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정. 본이 이 장수의 도끼 길이(151px)로 만들어져 있어 본의 무기 끝을 그대로 보낸다(clips/poleaxe.py). [자루] 원화의 자루를 손 아래에서 21px 줄인 사본(short-*.png)을 쓴다. 후면은 자루 끝이 망토 뒤로 들어가 보이지 않는다(사용자 확인 2026-11-19). 승인 원본은 그대로다.
